notes.manas-2010:p0638:b001:l002: Ала буурул read as dappled-roan animals flourishing in spring, with май чачып an abundance/fat image; exact implied noun is absent. Literal horse-color reading remains qualified, not silently converted into rain or snow.
notes.manas-2010:p0638:b001:l005: ат кара тил болгондо is early-summer grazing season: horses have darkened tongues from grass, not a disease. Yudakhin/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/АТ%20КАРА%20ТИЛ%20БОЛГОНДО/.
notes.manas-2010:p0638:b001:l011: Bakay shifts between self-reference in third person and first person; retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0638:b001:l020: карагай rendered pine in cache narrative; may denote conifer/tree collectively rather than a specified botanical species. No hollow-tree construction invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0638:b001:l024: салык is stored/cached belongings, not tax here: Yudakhin салык I.3, https://el-sozduk.kg/салык/. Same reading l028 and640:l014.
notes.manas-2010:p0638:b001:l027: Opening markings is awkward in the printed source; retained as opening the marked cache, without inventing a locked container.
notes.manas-2010:p0638:b001:l036: сары изине чөп салуу = relentless pursuit, not literally putting grass on footprints; previously verified contextual lexicon.
notes.manas-2010:p0639:b001:l010: Absence of a fresh horse is a complaint about relief mounts; does not erase the gray steed he is riding.
notes.manas-2010:p0639:b001:l014: Dark crumbling house is a source fragment before the frail-soul formula. Literal image retained without assigning an unsupported house owner or repairing verse.
notes.manas-2010:p0639:b001:l020: кырымы = fine workmanship/quality in epic gun descriptions: Yudakhin кырым II, https://el-sozduk.kg/кырым/. No geographical Crimea reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0639:b001:l025: Source visual reflow touches this line to l026 on the same rendered baseline. Separate extracted verse units retained provisionally; no claim of definitive metrical lineation.
notes.manas-2010:p0639:b001:l032: Source explicitly says арман жок, no regret, despite preceding and following lament. Negative retained; not emended to much sorrow.
notes.manas-2010:p0639:b001:l033: мураа inherited ancestral property: edition glossary1841:l012. Kelte is source shortened name of Akkelte, not a second gun.
notes.manas-2010:p0640:b001:l018: артынан following behind understood of driving off livestock, anticipated l020; supplied object qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0640:b001:l024: кээсин чыгаруу teach a lesson/take revenge, Yudakhin кээ I https://el-sozduk.kg/кээ/. Not some of the brains from preceding line.
notes.manas-2010:p0640:b001:l030: керчөө literally fatty breast cut with skin, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/керч/. Violent breast-hacking image retained; application to a human giant is contextual, not silently coat or skull.
notes.manas-2010:p0640:b001:l040: кош бадана, торгой көз: double mail with small lark-eye rings, edition glossary1839. Following оодарышып turning/reversing armor retained without inventing a technical fastening.
notes.manas-2010:p0641:b001:l006: каңкы saddle; white saddle as pillow, not a white bed. Direction to Mecca l007 is qibla translated into English.
notes.manas-2010:p0641:b001:l010: Кызыр spiritual patron rendered established Kydyr. Baabedin l012/l023 is another proper-name invocation; blessings inferred from чалган protective formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0641:b001:l014: көңүлү ташып бөлүнүп retained as overflowing/set apart; awkward final participle and its subject are uncertain in witness.
notes.manas-2010:p0641:b001:l017: миң сан кол: thousand vast armies, preserving explicit thousand while treating сан as epic multitude unit; no invented exact census.
notes.manas-2010:p0641:b001:l019: супа садык first true dawn, edition glossary1842:l030–031, not an untranslated liturgical phrase.
notes.manas-2010:p0641:b001:l020: канзаада princely descent: edition glossary1838:l036, translated rather than left as a rank transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p0641:b001:l037: буулум costly thick cloth, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/БУУЛУМ/; exact weave unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0642:b001:l003: Human Azhybay is praised as a steed, repeated racer metaphor l013; not confused with his actual mount.
notes.manas-2010:p0642:b001:l009: бурку kind/type, edition glossary1836:l016; seventy kinds of speech, exact number preserved also643:l029.
notes.manas-2010:p0642:b001:l030: эшен spiritual master, молдо l033 religious scholar, кожо l037 holy man: contextual English glosses rather than opaque rank transliterations.
notes.manas-2010:p0642:b001:l031: өңгүл-дөңгүл literally uneven/varied, rendered all sorts of people; not an unsupported physical-disability claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0642:b001:l035: жорго pacer image continues praise of smooth fluent speech, not a literal change into a horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0642:b001:l036: бозо cereal beer rendered millet beer, conventional composition; source does not specify recipe. Drinking and beating a holy man l037 retained despite preceding piety.
notes.manas-2010:p0642:b001:l039: даңгыл brazen/open, contextual character trait; qualified rendering, no additional moral condemnation.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l002: туз буйруп allotted salt/sustenance, formula of destined encounter and hospitality; no literal salt command.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l007: барчын a mature eagle in hunting vocabulary; dark-mottled image kept. Subsequent шуңкар falcon distinguished.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l012: далбаа waving lure/action to direct hunting bird; English preserves falconry setting without a modern command mechanism.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l016: кылыгың чечер interpreted satisfying/answering your desires from repeated кумарың чечер l022; printed кылык retained in extraction, contextual reading qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l017: ай караңгы жаздашып awkward seasonal phrase rendered moon-dark springtime, supported by spring setting641:l033. жаздашып exact construction uncertain; no textual emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l025: ажайып wondrous lore, not a confidently identified school/place/book title.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l032: Explicit он retained as ten conquests, not silently оң or a single conquest. Rendered line touches next extracted line; provisional display segmentation preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l036: көйкашка renowned/outstanding hero, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/koy-12/; not a place-name.
notes.manas-2010:p0643:b001:l042: Камбар ата horse patron: dear creature of Father Kambar, with following balanced birth/form. Does not assert that Kambar is biologically the sire; preceding ordinary stallion/mare pedigree retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l002: Stallion left then horse gelded, literal breeding/gelding language retained despite later stallion-like command over other horses.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l007: азар түмөн epic very great multitude of horses, not a securely enumerated herd. Countless hosts preserves abundance without multiplying fixed modern numbers.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l013: кыл куйрук horsehair tail is metonymy for horses; unusual literal image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l015: Racing up and joining is contextually the horse being encountered; source subject and object remain implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l023: кандагай trousers of mountain-goat skin, edition glossary1838:l034–035; no unexplained garment transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l026: Кыйба established Khiva place-name; дилде gold coins, denomination not forced into modern value.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l027: кара көз one dark-eyed person interpreted a girl taken in conquest; gender is contextual, no marriage or consent invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0644:b001:l030: Source predicate and possessor cross l030–031; final English keeps reveal on l030 and tangled temperament l031 to improve source-row correspondence.
notes.manas-2010:p0645:b001:l003: өлбөгөн жерде калышып barely surviving rather than locating an immortal land; contextual idiomatic reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0645:b001:l007: сан/түмөн multitude expressions translated countless/vast herds with no invented census. Renunciation of wealth not divorce from a named wife.
notes.manas-2010:p0645:b001:l016: Printed бирге read from бир spiritual guide/pir variant, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/Бир/; exact parallel twelve guides in https://el-sozduk.kg/калы/. Not twelve plus one arithmetic.
notes.manas-2010:p0645:b001:l017: Prayers associated with ten spiritual masters, source ablative эшенден could imply instruction received from them; with is qualified compressed English.
notes.manas-2010:p0645:b001:l018: калыйпа caliph, edition glossary1838:l032 and Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/калы/. No specific historical caliph identified.
notes.manas-2010:p0645:b001:l022: зайыппуруш illustrious epic champion, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/зайыппуруш/ and edition glossary1842:l016 onward. Not woman-seller inferred from apparent components.
notes.manas-2010:p0645:b001:l030: базар market as flourishing life/fortune image retained, not silently replaced with generic treasure.
notes.manas-2010:p0646:b001:l013: Wall-felt greased with fat is prosperity image. With plenty makes figurative force explicit; source image kept.
notes.manas-2010:p0646:b001:l016: Parenthetical l016–017 rendered in parentheses and counted as verse, not editorial heading.
notes.manas-2010:p0646:b001:l018: Желпиниш preserved as source place-name; no modern location asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0646:b001:l024: ат бороюн сыдыруу wearing horse down through long travel, ribs image; not literally skinning a living horse. Repeats655:l040.
notes.manas-2010:p0646:b001:l031: зардал leader/chief, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/зардал/. English rank gloss used.
notes.manas-2010:p0646:b001:l033: Ажы shortened personal name Azhy in this passage, not independently translated pilgrim title.
notes.manas-2010:p0646:b001:l034: арбак ancestral/spiritual might, rendered spiritual might rather than asserting a visible ghost.
notes.manas-2010:p0647:b001:l001: жосун order/proper conduct, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/жосун/; settling proper course is qualified idiomatic application.
notes.manas-2010:p0647:b001:l019: жыйгандаш sharer in acquired wealth, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/жыйгандаш/, not merely companion at gatherings.
notes.manas-2010:p0647:b001:l021: ыймандаш faith companion, in death context perhaps one reciting final creed/funeral prayers. English avoids adding an unprinted ritual.
notes.manas-2010:p0647:b001:l023: кайсы дартын which care/trouble retained amid praise; not silently altered to virtues.
notes.manas-2010:p0647:b001:l025: байдалаш interpreted sharing gains, source dialectal байда for пайда. Context raid partnership; qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0647:b001:l027: кул servant retained for Azhybay also l029, despite princely status; not omitted as an embarrassing contradiction.
notes.manas-2010:p0648:b001:l008: Six days here versus six months641:l001 retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0648:b001:l012: амаз source form of намаз, ritual prayer; translated prayers without changing raw.
notes.manas-2010:p0648:b001:l021: кары бою read length of one кары, half an armspan (traditional measure), in coat-of-armor context; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кары/. күрөөкө has costly coat and armor senses; preceding bulletproof selects armor. Exact compressed construction qualified, no metric conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0648:b001:l026: Other-world confidant means sworn friendship extending to afterlife, not a different currently supernatural Bakay.
notes.manas-2010:p0648:b001:l036: чыбыр hillocks/uneven small-hill terrain, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чыбыр/; final correction from tracks. будур ала rough/mottled retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0649:b001:l005: кол ыштык single-opening hide-smoking pit; exact nostril-steam simile in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/ыштык/.
notes.manas-2010:p0649:b001:l014: окоро round braid, edition glossary1841:l029; not gun-loading.
notes.manas-2010:p0649:b001:l017: эри өлгөндөй like a bereaved wife whose husband died; striking widow-mourning simile retained for tossing horses, not silently master instead of husband.
notes.manas-2010:p0649:b001:l024: Bits clanging in throats is printed anatomy, not silently normalized to mouths.
notes.manas-2010:p0649:b001:l031: Ак-Талаа source place-name preserved; no modern geographical identification forced.
notes.manas-2010:p0649:b001:l038: Sweat from flanks/armpits understood as horses in riding sequence; rider sweat also possible, subject implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0650:b001:l014: жылтыркан Yudakhin kochia prostrata, forage kochia, https://el-sozduk.kg/жылтыркан/ (retrieved direct HTTP). бетеге fescue. Botanical precision comes from dictionary, not field identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0650:b001:l015: борбуюн hocks here differs from бороюн ribs/wasting formula elsewhere; visible source difference retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0650:b001:l025: өзү тургай emphatic not only himself preceding dark-eyes recognition formula; literal construction is unusual, not silently made a likeness or different person.
notes.manas-2010:p0650:b001:l035: Printed Чөнөрдөн has н, dictionary чөңөр has ң and means hard sharp grass/reed stubble: https://el-sozduk.kg/чөңөр/. English sharp stubble is a qualified contextual variant reading, not proven emendation. Chönör as a toponym cannot be ruled out; no invented place identification. Raw retained: Чөнөрдөн бөкөн кубалап,.
notes.manas-2010:p0650:b001:l036: чөөлүк- become exhausted, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чөөлүк/. Final English means felling exhausted quarry, not open desert ground.
notes.manas-2010:p0651:b001:l007: саяң sparse/scant tail in paired scant mane; morphology qualified, not a claim of surgically docked tail.
notes.manas-2010:p0651:b001:l015: казы belly/rib fat and карта large intestine of equines; English distinguishes fat and intestines instead of substituting a modern sausage recipe.
notes.manas-2010:p0651:b001:l016: жан казан portable traveling cooking pot, edition glossary1837:l032. Same reading657:l014.
notes.manas-2010:p0651:b001:l020: чидер hobble restraining legs; no capture of a person.
notes.manas-2010:p0651:b001:l031: Repeated dark-gazing-eyes recognition formula retained though previous lines explicitly say asleep with shut eyes.
notes.manas-2010:p0651:b001:l042: Subject shifts to Manas upon seeing sleeper, confirmed652:l006; no attack by sleeping Azhybay invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0652:b001:l002: кесип салганы read as purpose/preparation to behead, governed by taking sword651:l042 and readying652:l006. Narrative intervention and live awakening exclude a completed beheading; grammatical interpretation explicitly noted.
notes.manas-2010:p0652:b001:l004: Manas first declares certain enemy then cannot distinguish friend/foe l007–009. Contradiction retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0653:b001:l012: Салоодон qualified blessing/prayer formula associated with салоот and салам алейкүм; https://el-sozduk.kg/салоо/. Entire greeting rendered English; exact initial malformed word uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0653:b001:l018: капысынан чыгарып awkward causative in startled greeting. Caught by surprise is contextual interpretation; raw retained, no physical ejection from camp invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0653:b001:l026: Devouring those encountered retained as fierce boast, not softened to defeating.
notes.manas-2010:p0654:b001:l010: эгиз equal/twin in companionship sense; absence of khan retained despite known father Argyn Khan.
notes.manas-2010:p0654:b001:l016: кыпкызыл literally vivid red retained with iron-rope net; likely figurative severe trap, not literal newly erected net invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0654:b001:l020: көөнүң as at your wish: Yudakhin/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/көөн/. Not keep your own heart alive.
notes.manas-2010:p0654:b001:l030: Wings metaphor retained for weary traveler; no literal wings added to human body.
notes.manas-2010:p0655:b001:l007: жал here fat along horse mane/neck in emaciation metaphor, not merely hair falling out; no actual transformation asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0655:b001:l012: жая horse rump meat, English gloss rather than culinary transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p0655:b001:l016: Зулпукор retained as named sword in epic boast, red spear treated alongside it. No ownership transfer of Manas weapon invented; source lacks explicit conjunction.
notes.manas-2010:p0655:b001:l017: көөлө- wield/set weapon in action, exact Yudakhin Zulpukor example https://el-sozduk.kg/көөлө/; not soot-smearing here.
notes.manas-2010:p0655:b001:l019: кылым interpreted people/world in epic collective sense, not a historical century of battle.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l003: төрө noble title translated, not non-name rank transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l007: каркыбар affectionate praise of a brave fellow, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/каркыбар/.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l008: болжош guiding sign/landmark, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/болжош/, including star-guidance example. Not a divination technique.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l017: Twelve years old in this retelling retained without harmonization to earlier childhood chronology.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l022: Letter from unseen realm literal source imagery; not silently blessing or a documented historical letter.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l023: Бурут historical external ethnonym retained, not replaced silently with Kyrgyz. Bloodthirsty epithet preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l025: даңза register/record, contextual administrative English, not an invented secret assassination list.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l031: Implicit subject read as Bakay mediating between Azhybay and Manas; English he leaves ambiguity rather than naming a new mediator.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l038: Embracing and kissing between male sworn friends explicitly retained; no deletion or sexualization.
notes.manas-2010:p0656:b001:l039: Traditional twelve limbs/forty veins anatomy retained without modern correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0657:b001:l002: боз pale/mist-colored retained with mist simile; emotional grief/tears possible, not silently replaced by crying.
notes.manas-2010:p0657:b001:l006: Exact antelope-hair formula means becoming close heartfelt friends: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/суурулуш/. Hair simile remains l005; final English gives idiomatic friendship instead of misleading physical pulling apart.
notes.manas-2010:p0657:b001:l011: жошулуш flow/speak freely together; spring simile retained, qualified social imagery.
notes.manas-2010:p0657:b001:l012: Barren wild-ass mares, not simply all wild asses; four/five slaughter and still half-fed l017 epic appetite retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0657:b001:l027: Writing knotted in belt interpreted sacred written charm in oath context, not a specified Quran verse or identified document.
notes.manas-2010:p0657:b001:l029: милте gun matchcord, blue source color retained, not an explosive bomb fuse.
notes.manas-2010:p0657:b001:l032: Shaggy-breasted earth/open-crowned sky l033 literal oath imagery, not normalized to plain earth/heaven.
